additional_kwargs.reasoning_content: Need runs with metadata maybe containing agent name? pr-reviewer runs likely have metadata->>'agent' or input. Assume runs where metadata->>'agent' = 'pr-reviewer'. Count distinct tool_name in tool_calls for those runs created before 2026-10-28. Use runs.created_at < '2026-10-28'. Join.

function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tc.tool_name) AS distinct_tools
FROM runs r
JOIN tool_calls tc ON tc.run_id = r.id
WHERE r.created_at < '2026-10-28'::date
  AND r.metadata->>'agent' = 'pr-reviewer';"}
function.name: query_database

args.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tc.tool_name) AS distinct_tools
FROM runs r
JOIN tool_calls tc ON tc.run_id = r.id
WHERE r.created_at < '2026-10-28'::date
  AND r.metadata->>'agent' = 'pr-reviewer';
